instructions.1: Whisk the eggs well, then add the cornstarch or custard powder and mix thoroughly.
instructions.2: Boil the milk with the sugar over medium heat, then remove from the stove.
instructions.3: Add the egg mixture to the milk and stir well, then return to low heat while whisking constantly until it thickens for use, then sprinkle with vanilla.
instructions.4: Mix in the chopped chocolate or cocoa powder until the color turns brown.

db114-3.name: Banana, strawberry, guava, peach, or pineapple

instructions.1: Blend the milk with your choice of fruit (such as banana, strawberry, guava, peach, or pineapple) and sugar in a blender.
instructions.2: Using an electric hand mixer, pour the fruit-milk mixture into a bowl, add the Chantilly cream powder, and whip for approximately 3 minutes.

instructions.1: Place the sugar and a little water in a pan and cook until it turns golden brown like caramel.
instructions.2: Pour the cream or double cream into the caramel, lower the heat, and stir carefully to ensure it melts completely.
instructions.3: Add the grated chocolate to the mixture.

db116-4.name: Unsweetened cocoa powder or chocolate powder

instructions.1: Whisk all ingredients together until well combined.
instructions.2: Place the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly until the consistency becomes smooth and liquid.
instructions.3: You can double the ingredients to ensure enough to cover the entire cake surface.

instructions.1: Beat the butter well, then gradually add the sugar while continuing to whisk. Add the fine orange zest and beat everything together thoroughly.

des-113.title: Whipped Jam or Jelly Meringue Topping

instructions.1: Melt the jelly or jam in a water bath until it reaches a thin consistency.
instructions.2: Whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form.
instructions.3: Add the jelly or jam to the egg whites and whisk well until the consistency is medium, making it easy to spread over the cake surface.

osool-001.title: Dark Broth (Brown Stock)
osool-001.culturalNotes: This broth is the base for the clear soups and brown sauces in the book; the onion is browned to give it its dark color.

instructions.1: Chop the onion and fry it in the ghee until it turns dark, then let the pot cool slightly.
instructions.2: Trim the fat from the meat and cut it into small pieces; scoop the marrow out of the bones and rinse the bones quickly.
instructions.3: Add the meat, bones and cold water over the browned onion and set the pot aside for a while so the meat juices draw out into the water.
instructions.4: Place the pot over very low heat and leave it for about three hours without letting it boil.
instructions.5: Add the chopped vegetables, spices and salt and continue cooking for about two hours.
instructions.6: Strain the broth through a fine sieve and leave it in a cool place until the next day, then remove the layer of solidified fat from the surface.

osool-002-i5.name: Egg whites with their shells (for clarifying)

instructions.1: Mince the meat finely, separate the egg whites carefully, wash the shells well and crush them, and clean the vegetables, leaving them whole.
instructions.2: Put all the ingredients in a wide, spotlessly clean pot.
instructions.3: Set the pot over low heat and whisk the mixture vigorously and continuously until it is close to boiling, then remove the whisk.
instructions.4: Raise the heat and leave the soup undisturbed until the foamy egg-white layer sets and floats to the surface.
instructions.5: Lower the heat completely and leave the pot half covered for about 40 minutes.
instructions.6: Pour the soup through a thick cloth or dry tea towel, pouring the set layer in first so the rest of the liquid filters through it and comes out clear and transparent; strain a second time if needed.
instructions.7: Soup with vegetables: cut two carrots, a piece of celery root and a turnip into small cubes or thin sticks, boil them separately and rinse in cold water, then add them to the soup just before serving so it stays clear.
instructions.8: Winter soup: add a little carrot and turnip cut into small pea-sized balls, rounds of inner cabbage leaves, green peas and small cauliflower florets, at one part vegetables to six parts soup.
instructions.9: With rice or pasta: add 3 tablespoons of boiled, rinsed rice to the winter soup, or boil fine orzo-like pasta in salted water and add it to the soup.
instructions.10: Princess soup: for each liter of soup, add half a boiled chicken breast cut into cubes and 1 tablespoon of boiled, rinsed pearl barley just before serving.
instructions.11: Royal soup: for each egg yolk use 1 teaspoon of cream, milk or broth; mix and season, divide into two parts and tint one pink, steam each part in a greased mold until set, then unmold once cool, cut into decorative shapes and add to the soup.

instructions.1: Trim the fat from the meat and cut it into small pieces; cut the vegetables into small cubes.
instructions.2: Add the water to the meat and cook over low heat for an hour and a half, skimming off the scum whenever it appears. If using barley instead of rice, add it at this stage.
instructions.3: Add the rice and chopped vegetables and continue cooking until tender, about an hour.
instructions.4: Remove the bones and let the soup cool, then lift off the layer of fat from its surface.
instructions.5: Reheat the soup, add the chopped parsley and serve.
instructions.6: Lamb broth: use the same ingredients and method, but lift the meat out of the soup and serve it on its own with a little parsley or browned; serve the soup with bread toasted in the oven or fried and cut into triangles instead of the meat pieces.

osool-004-i4.name: French bread loaf, sliced into small rounds and toasted in the oven

instructions.1: Peel the turnip and carrot and cut them into small rounds; slice the bread into rounds and toast it in the oven.
instructions.2: Sauté the vegetable rounds in the butter.
instructions.3: Add the broth, salt, pepper and nutmeg and simmer over low heat until the vegetables are tender but not falling apart.
instructions.4: Sprinkle with parsley and serve hot with the toasted bread rounds.

instructions.1: Split the head, remove the brain and place it in salted water.
instructions.2: Remove the small bones and any hair, wash the head well with salt, taking care to clean the nose and eye sockets, then soak it in salted water for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the tongue, prepare it and cook it separately as you like.
instructions.4: Add the water to the head and cook over low heat for a full hour, skimming off the scum whenever it appears; add a whole onion, to be removed later.
instructions.5: Cut the vegetables into even pieces and add them with the rice, salt and spices; simmer the soup over low heat until done (about two hours), then lift out the head.
instructions.6: Add the chopped parsley and serve the soup hot; serve the head on its own, or take the meat off and cut it into small pieces to add to the soup.

instructions.1: Skin the rabbit, wash it well and cut the meat into fairly small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the water to the meat and bring the pot to a boil over low heat, skimming off the scum whenever it appears.
instructions.3: When the meat is nearly done, add the rice, the vegetables cut into small cubes and a little salt, and continue cooking until everything is tender.
instructions.4: Lift out the meat pieces, cut some of them into cubes and add them to the soup, then reheat and serve.
instructions.5: Serve the rest of the meat on its own, boiled, or with white sauce, or browned.

instructions.1: Peel, clean and wash the sprouted fava beans.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee or oil, add the mastic, then add the water and bring it to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the beans, the lemon and the peeled onion and cook over medium heat until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it rises; add the salt shortly before the beans are done.
instructions.4: Add the chopped parsley and boil the soup for five minutes, then season and serve hot.

osool-008-i3.name: Piece of white celery and an onion

osool-008-i8.name: Lemon juice or vinegar (to keep the artichokes)

instructions.1: Clean the artichokes by removing the leaves and the fuzzy choke, then slice them thinly and keep them in water with lemon juice or vinegar until needed.
instructions.2: Clean the vegetables and slice them thinly.
instructions.3: Sauté the artichokes and vegetables in the butter, then cover with the stock or water and cook until everything is tender.
instructions.4: Press the vegetables through a sieve, add most of the milk and bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Mix the flour well with a little milk and add it to the soup, stirring constantly, then return the pot to the heat and bring to a boil while stirring; season with salt and white pepper.
instructions.6: Add the cream at the end, taking care not to heat the soup after that, and serve.
instructions.7: Second method, without flour: ¾ kg artichokes, a piece of celery and an onion, 3 cups white stock, 1 tablespoon ghee and 1 cup milk; sauté the artichokes and vegetables in the ghee for 5 minutes, add the stock and bring to a boil, then lower the heat until the vegetables are tender; press through a sieve, add the milk, return to the heat and season.

instructions.1: Bring the asparagus to a boil in the salted water or stock.
instructions.2: Lift out the tender asparagus tips and set them aside to garnish the soup; leave the rest on the heat until tender, then press through a sieve.
instructions.3: Stir the ghee with the flour over the heat, then add the sieved asparagus, the water or stock it was boiled in, and the milk, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Season the soup, garnish with the asparagus tips and serve.
instructions.5: If using cream instead of milk, add it at the end and do not reheat the soup afterwards.

instructions.1: Wash the celery and slice it thinly; slice the onion the same way.
instructions.2: Sauté the vegetables in the ghee for 5 minutes, then add the stock and leave the pot on the heat until they are tender.
instructions.3: Add the flour mixed with the cold milk and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Strain the soup and reheat it, then take it off the heat, add the cream if using, and serve with the fried bread.

instructions.1: Shell and wash the peas.
instructions.2: Put the peas, onion, mint and stock in a pot over low heat until completely tender.
instructions.3: Press the vegetables through a sieve, return them to the pot and add the ghee.
instructions.4: Mix the flour or cornflour well with the milk and add it to the soup while stirring, then bring to a full boil, stirring.
instructions.5: Season the soup and add the cream and a little green coloring if desired.

instructions.1: Wash, peel and thinly slice the potatoes; slice the onion the same way.
instructions.2: Sauté the potatoes and onion in the ghee for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the stock or water and simmer over low heat until tender.
instructions.4: Press the soup through a fine-meshed strainer, return it to the heat and add the flour mixed well with the milk.
instructions.5: Cook, stirring, until it comes to a full boil and the flour is cooked, then season and serve hot.

instructions.1: Cut a cross into each chestnut, boil them for a quarter of an hour, then peel.
instructions.2: Sauté them in the butter, then add the stock and cook until tender (30 to 50 minutes).
instructions.3: Press through a hair sieve or fine-meshed strainer.
instructions.4: Mix the flour or cornflour well with the milk; return the sieved chestnuts to the heat and, when boiling, add the mixture while stirring well and let it come back to a boil.
instructions.5: Take the pot off the heat and let the soup cool slightly, then add the cream, season, and serve with the fried bread.

instructions.1: Sauté the pumpkin and onion in the ghee, then add the stock and seasonings and cook until completely tender; press through a sieve.
instructions.2: Return the purée to the heat with most of the milk and bring to a boil, stirring.
instructions.3: Mix the flour well with the rest of the cold milk and add it to the boiling soup, stirring well.
instructions.4: Let the soup boil for 5 minutes, stirring, then season and serve.
instructions.5: Second method: for ½ kg pumpkin, peel and cut into small pieces and sauté with a thinly sliced onion in 1 tablespoon ghee for 20 minutes; add 2 full cups of stock or water until tender, press through a sieve, add 1 tablespoon flour mixed with ½ cup milk and return to the heat for 3 minutes, stirring.

instructions.1: Wash the peas well and soak them in cold water for 12 hours.
instructions.2: Sauté the peas and the chopped vegetables (if using) in the butter for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the stock and leave the pot on the heat until the peas are completely tender, then press the soup through a sieve.
instructions.4: Mix the flour well with the water or milk, add it to the sieved soup and boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.5: Season, add a little green coloring if desired, and serve.

instructions.1: Wash the meat and cut it into very small pieces; cut the vegetables into cubes.
instructions.2: Put the meat, vegetables, stock and spices in a pot over low heat until the meat and vegetables are tender, then strain to separate them from the liquid.
instructions.3: Bring the soup liquid to a boil and add the cornflour or flour mixed with a little cold water, stirring well.
instructions.4: Boil again for 5 minutes, then add the reserved vegetables and meat and serve.

instructions.1: Wash the rabbit and cut it into pieces; put it in a pot with the onions, cardamom, celery, mastic and water.
instructions.2: Cook over low heat until the meat is tender, skimming off the scum whenever it appears.
instructions.3: Strain the soup and lift out the meat to serve at the table as desired; let the liquid cool, then remove the layer of fat from its surface.
instructions.4: Bring the liquid to a boil, then add the flour mixed with the cold milk, stirring well, and let it boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Serve the soup with the fried bread cubes.

osool-018-i5.name: Boiled vegetables cut into decorative shapes

instructions.1: Melt the butter or ghee, add the flour and stir over the heat briefly without letting it color.
instructions.2: Add the stock gradually, stirring well, and bring to a boil while stirring constantly; let it boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Mix the egg yolks and cream together, then strain the mixture into the liquid, provided it is not too hot.
instructions.4: Reheat the soup over low heat without boiling until the eggs are cooked.
instructions.5: Season, add a little lemon juice, then add the cut vegetables and serve.

osool-019.title: Soup Thickened with Egg and Cream

osool-019-i5.name: Fried or toasted bread cubes, for serving

instructions.1: Beat the egg yolks and add them to the cream.
instructions.2: Heat the stock until it is almost boiling.
instructions.3: Take the stock off the heat and add the yolk and cream mixture, stirring well.
instructions.4: Return the pot to very low heat, or set it beside the heat, and keep stirring until the soup thickens, making sure it does not boil or it will separate.
instructions.5: Season with salt and pepper and serve with the fried or toasted bread.

osool-020.title: Soup Thickened with Egg and Lemon

instructions.1: Separate the yolks and add a little salt, white pepper and the lemon juice; stir well.
instructions.2: Heat the stock until it boils.
instructions.3: Pour the hot stock over the yolk mixture, stirring well, and serve at once.

osool-021.title: Soup Thickened with Flour and Lemon

instructions.1: Bring the stock to a boil, then take the pot off the heat.
instructions.2: Mix the flour well with a little cold stock and add it to the pot, stirring well.
instructions.3: Return the pot to the heat and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Season with salt and pepper, add the lemon juice and serve.

instructions.1: Bring the stock to a boil and sprinkle in the tapioca, stirring well.
instructions.2: Keep it on the heat, stirring, for 20 minutes.
instructions.3: Beat the egg yolks with the cream; let the soup cool slightly, then add the mixture.
instructions.4: Reheat the soup without letting it boil, season and serve.

osool-023.title: Egyptian-Style White Fish Soup
osool-023.culturalNotes: Fish soup is light and economical; its broth can be made from any cheap, lean fish, or even from fish bones, skin and heads. It is usually served to the sick and during fasting periods.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and fry the mastic in it, then add the water, salt, cardamom, onion and celery and bring to a boil.
instructions.2: Add the prepared fish and the lemon juice and leave the pot on the heat until the fish is cooked.
instructions.3: Serve the soup with the fish cut into even pieces and sprinkled with chopped parsley, or serve the fish separately garnished with lemon and parsley and the soup on its own.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and fry the mastic and cardamom in it, then sauté the fish in it and lift it out.
instructions.2: Add the water to the ghee and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Dissolve the flour in a little water and add it to the boiling water, stirring well; let it boil for 10 minutes so the flour cooks, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Add the fish and cook over low heat until nearly done, then add the chopped parsley and celery.
instructions.5: Take the pot off the heat once the fish is fully cooked and add the lemon juice.

instructions.1: Prepare the fish, then poach it with the prepared vegetables; add the salt, pepper and cloves and cook until it is just done.
instructions.2: Lift the fish out of the liquid, remove the skin and bones, and cut the flesh into small, even pieces.
instructions.3: Return the bones and skin to the liquid and boil for no more than half an hour, then strain the liquid.
instructions.4: Mix the flour well with the milk and add it to the strained broth; boil for five minutes, then add the cut fish and boil again for 3 to 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Add the lemon juice and chopped parsley and serve hot.

osool-026.title: Dark Fish Soup (Coastal Style)
osool-026.culturalNotes: This soup is popular in the coastal cities; it gets its dark color from frying the onion in oil.

instructions.1: Slice the onion thinly and fry it in the oil until it is well darkened.
instructions.2: Pour the water over it, add the salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the fish and cook until done.
instructions.4: Lift out the fish and serve it on its own, or remove its skin and bones and cut it into suitable pieces to add to the strained soup.

osool-901.title: Boiled Eggs, Served Several Ways (Fried and with Mayonnaise)
osool-901.culturalNotes: Keep the heat neither high nor fast, so the white does not set too quickly and stop the heat reaching the yolk.

instructions.1: Soft-boiled eggs: drop the eggs into boiling water and boil for 3½ to 4 minutes depending on size; or drop them into boiling water and cover the pot off the heat for 5 to 10 minutes; or put them in cold water, bring to a boil over low heat, then leave for one minute.
instructions.2: Hard-boiled eggs: put the eggs in cold water, bring to a boil over low heat and cook for 15 minutes after boiling, then leave in cold water until ready to peel.
instructions.3: Fried boiled eggs (mera'lel): heat the ghee until very hot and fry the peeled hard-boiled eggs in it; lift out, sprinkle with salt and pepper, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley; tomato sauce may be served alongside.
instructions.4: Eggs with mayonnaise: leave the cold hard-boiled eggs whole or halve them lengthwise; arrange on a plate, cover with the mayonnaise and garnish with chopped parsley.

osool-902.title: Hard-Boiled Eggs in White Sauce ('Sun Disc')

osool-902-i3.name: Small fried bread triangles (for the second method)

instructions.1: Peel the eggs and cut into rounds or halve lengthwise, keeping back the yolks of two eggs.
instructions.2: Arrange the eggs on a warm plate and cover with the hot white sauce.
instructions.3: Sieve the reserved yolks over the top to form a sun with its rays, and serve hot.
instructions.4: Second method: halve the eggs and separate the yolks from the whites; chop the whites coarsely, add them to the hot sauce and season; put on a warm plate, decorate the top with the yolk halves and chopped parsley, and set the bread triangles around the plate.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee until very hot and fry the onion in it until browned.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until done, then add the parsley and water, season with salt and pepper and boil for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the peeled eggs to the tomato sauce and cook over low heat for 5 minutes, turning them halfway through.
instructions.4: Lift the eggs out of the sauce and halve them lengthwise or leave whole.
instructions.5: Arrange the eggs on a plate and pour the tomato sauce over them.
instructions.6: The eggs and tomatoes can be served inside a ring of mashed potatoes.

osool-904-i3.name: For the curry sauce: small onion and ghee

osool-904-i4.name: For the curry sauce: curry powder and flour

osool-904-i6.name: For the curry sauce: chopped apple and lemon juice

instructions.1: Make the curry sauce: fry the onion in the ghee, then add the curry powder, flour and apple, then the stock gradually while stirring; simmer over low heat for half an hour and add the lemon.
instructions.2: Peel the eggs, add them to the sauce and leave for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Lift the eggs out of the sauce and halve them lengthwise.
instructions.4: Arrange the rice on the plate in a hollow ring.
instructions.5: Place the eggs inside the ring and pour the sauce over them or around the rice.

osool-905.title: Stuffed Eggs (with Anchovy, Cream or Mayonnaise)

osool-905-i7.name: Paprika and a little red food coloring

osool-905-i9.name: Tomato, cucumber or beet rounds, for serving

instructions.1: Peel the eggs and cut each in half crosswise, trimming a small piece off the bottom of each half so it stands steadily.
instructions.2: Remove the yolks and press them through a wire sieve or mash them well.
instructions.3: With anchovy: add the butter, anchovy essence (or wiped, boned and pounded anchovies) and paprika to the yolks; work the mixture until completely smooth and tint it lightly.
instructions.4: Put the mixture in a paper or cloth piping bag with a rosette tip and pipe rosettes into the egg-white halves.
instructions.5: Set each on a round of tomato, cucumber or cooked beet.
instructions.6: With cream: add the whipped cream, parsley and salt to the sieved yolks and pipe rosettes into the whites; serve on a bed of green salad.
instructions.7: Cream eggs (no. 2): halve the eggs lengthwise; mix the sieved yolks with 1½ tablespoons butter, 2 tablespoons whipped cream, salt and pepper; fill the whites with the mixture, then press each two halves together to form a whole egg and decorate the seam with small rosettes of the mixture.
instructions.8: With mayonnaise: made like the cream eggs, replacing the cream with mayonnaise.

instructions.1: Add the vinegar or lemon and the salt to the boiling water.
instructions.2: Carefully break an egg into a cup.
instructions.3: Stir the water in a circle and gently pour in the egg, neatening its edges so it takes a round shape; leave for 2 to 3 minutes.
instructions.4: Lift out carefully with a slotted spoon and drain.
instructions.5: Place on a round of buttered toast and serve hot.
instructions.6: In milk: like poached eggs in water, using milk instead of water and leaving out the vinegar or lemon.
instructions.7: In tomato: like eggs poached in milk, replacing the milk with a light tomato sauce.
instructions.8: With spinach: make ¼ kg spinach purée and spread it on the plate; poach the eggs, place them on top and serve at once, hot.
instructions.9: With rumi cheese: place the poached eggs on buttered toast rounds; melt 1 tablespoon butter and add 1 tablespoon milk, 1 heaped tablespoon grated rumi cheese, ¼ teaspoon mustard, a little paprika and salt; stir over low heat until thick, cover the eggs with it and garnish with parsley.

osool-907.title: Eggs Baked in Shells with Spinach and White Sauce

instructions.1: Brush four scallop shells with warm ghee and put a layer of spinach in each.
instructions.2: Place a poached egg on the spinach layer.
instructions.3: Cover the egg with a layer of white sauce.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the rumi cheese on top and bake in a hot oven until browned, then serve at once.
instructions.5: Hard-boiled eggs in shells: slice 6 hard-boiled eggs into rounds and arrange in greased shells; cover with 1 cup cheese sauce, sprinkle the top with breadcrumbs, dot with small pieces of butter and bake in a hot oven until browned; garnish with parsley.

osool-908-i2.name: Butter or vegetable ghee
osool-908-i2.standardAmount: a walnut-sized piece or 1 level tablespoon per egg

osool-908-i4.name: Square or round pieces of fried bread or buttered toast

instructions.1: Break the eggs, add the milk, salt and pepper and mix everything together.
instructions.2: Melt the butter or ghee, add the mixture and stir quickly over low heat; take the pan off the heat when the mixture has set a little.
instructions.3: Put the scrambled eggs on the prepared bread, garnish with parsley and serve hot.
